protocol.predictor: September monthly NOAA CPC OISST Nino3.4 absolute SST (equivalent to a fixed September anomaly with regression intercept)
protocol.target: Texas total precipitation in ensuing December-February, indexed by February year
protocol.forecast_at: October 15 after September observations; two-week final-product latency assumption
protocol.model: Expanding OLS with intercept and September SST; initial 15 winters train, all subsequent winters test; no horizon/state/parameter search
protocol.uncertainty: paired RMSE reduction with circular 2-winter blocks, 10000 draws
protocol.gate: At least 5% lower RMSE than both comparators; positive 95% paired block interval vs climatology; improvement in MAE too
protocol.data_vintage: current NOAA archived indexes and revised precipitation; not original vintage
protocol.reason: Prior established ENSO mechanism; root fixed September->Texas DJF before outcome calculation

availability.predictor: Assumed September end +14 days, from OISST final latency; CPC monthly original release timestamps not preserved
availability.labels: Assumed April 1 after target winter; current revised NCEI archive
availability.vintage: Current OISST index includes historical reprocessing and in-situ inputs; chronological hindcast only
